surface.why: Coordinators already answer returns questions in Teams. A separate web app would need adoption we have no budget to drive during a pilot.
surface.who_can_use: The 12 named returns coordinators in the Alpine District pilot group.

permissions.access_denied_behavior: Returns the abstention string with no title, snippet, or existence signal for the restricted document.

rollback.mechanism: Repoint the agent version selector to the previous version; the published surface and endpoint URL are unchanged.

operations.how_users_report_a_bad_answer: The 'Report an answer' link in the agent's welcome message files a ticket to the Returns Ops queue with the conversation id.
operations.review_cadence: Weekly for the first month, then monthly.

pilot_exit.criterion: Either coordinators resolve 60% of policy lookups without escalating to a supervisor by week 6, or the pilot stops and we write up why.

evidence: Module 7 red-team results across jailbreak, harmful content, and indirect injection, with the retrieved-content mitigation applied and re-tested
Module 7 traced request 8f2c1ad4 showing model, retrieval, and tool spans
Module 2 permission probe re-run against the published surface on 2026-02-18
Eight decision records, one per module

release_decision.conditions: Pilot group stays at 12 named users until the week-4 review.
